findings.issue: Qal passive participle masculine plural describes the state of the 1cp subject of נַעֲבֹר. “extractos” is a noun and reads as the object of “pasaremos,” so the subject passes extracts instead of crossing in that passive state.
מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן places the possession on the region-beyond relative to the Jordan. “desde otro lado al Jordán” resolves ל as allative and states a path from another side to the Jordan.
Unmarked “a” is grammatical smoothing so the land can be the destination of the crossing verb; ארץ has no preposition of its own.

notes: Pronoun, imperfect 1cp, לפני Jehová, land of Canaán, and the verbless “with us + possession of our inheritance” match the tokens.
